Hi Julia —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

- Demo highlights: Dedicated capacity option for predictable throughput, private deployment for regulated data, and cost controls via Redwood Optimize.
- Action items we discussed:
  1) Procurement intake & vendor setup (your team) — confirm PO vs card and any vendor portal requirements.
  2) Legal/procurement asks — W-9, vendor form, banking details.
  3) Marketplace interest — you mentioned checking whether Acme prefers to buy via cloud marketplace; we can support AWS marketplace listing and provide pricing SKU if helpful.

Attached is our vendor information packet to speed intake: Vendor_Information_Packet_Redwood.pdf (includes W-9, bank letter template, and Vendor Setup FAQ). Please let me know which documents you need in separate files or if your portal requires a specific format.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm payment path (PO + net terms vs. card).
- If PO: we’ll send W-9 + bank letter and complete your vendor form.
- If card: share billing contact and we can process on the card once contract is signed.

Please ping me or loop in procurement@redwood.com if you want a short intake call. Happy to coordinate times.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0198

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the packet and the clear recap. We had a quick review with procurement and here’s where we land:

- Payment path: Acme prefers to pay by PO with net-30 terms for new vendors.
- Procurement needs: Completed vendor setup form (attached as a template in our portal), W-9 (for US vendors), and banking details for ACH payments.
- Vendor portal: We use an internal vendor portal. I created a ticket for this intake: https://app.acme-analytics.com/procurement/tickets/PA-48291 — they’ll update the ticket with next steps once they receive the docs.

Can you send: W-9 (PDF), a bank letter or voided check for ACH, and a completed copy of our vendor form? We’ll also need a copy of the signed Master Services Agreement (MSA) when available for the PO file.

Thanks — if it helps I’m happy to jump on a 15-min call with your procurement/legal team to walk through the portal fields.

Best,
Julia Smith
Head of Procurement Operations | Acme Analytics
julia.smith@acme-analytics.com
